defect: generate alternative selected by a localparam fixed to 0 can never be elaborated
rationale: UseSyncReset is a localparam set to 1'b0, so the g_cnt_sync_rst branch is unreachable in every instantiation and cannot be overridden.
author: claude-sonnet-5-5

provenance.adaptation: Reduced to a single-width counter with a localparam reset-style selector and removed the FPGA DSP and 64-bit variants.

labels.note: The constant generate condition selects the intended reset implementation.

settled_by.reason: UseSyncReset is a non-overridable localparam fixed to zero, so g_cnt_sync_rst can never elaborate; the unreachable alternative is LC18.
